_comment: Generate-and-score settings (Step 2c, docs/design/template-contract.md §5). Each slide's candidates are (valid variants) x (type_scale steps) x (anchors); hard constraints reject a candidate, soft scores (0-1) are combined with 'weights'. Candidates within 'tie_margin' of the best total are a tie, broken by variant order (data-specific variants first), then step, then anchor. Sizes are points. The beauty gate is calibrated from the first gallery run (see 'beauty_gate.calibration').
_type_scale: Trick 17: each template defines three content sizes in its layouts: display (kpi_value_1 of matn:kpi:cards; hero-number values use matn:kpi:hero-number's own display), title (the deck's title size, from title_sizes) and body (item_1 of matn:finding:cards-3). A step scales display and body by its factor, rounded to whole points (hero values never below 96 pt). Every content text uses one of the three: card headings, labels, quotes, markers, units and chart text are body size. A KPI value that does not fit at display size snaps to the title size. Chrome (source chip, tracker) is a fixed meta size and does not count.

beauty_gate.calibration: Calibrated on the first 2c run (2026-10-03, specimen v3, 7 templates). Mean chosen score per template: 0.946-0.951, Ion Boardroom 0.910. Reference points from the same candidates: a 2b-style choice (first valid variant, step S, top) averages 0.753-0.816, and an arbitrary valid candidate 0.829-0.865. 0.90 sits above every template's arbitrary-candidate mean and just under the lowest current template, so a template whose best layouts score no better than arbitrary ones fails.
